name: Mood Slider
description: Full-screen mood selector where dragging a three-step range slider slides between animated negative, neutral and positive characters while the background color changes.
contents: Three animated SVG characters (negative, neutral, positive) in a horizontal runner
Three-step range slider fixed at the bottom of the screen
behavior: Slider input slides the runner horizontally by viewport width and fades the background color
Each character plays its own looping GSAP timeline while active
GSAP is loaded as an npm dynamic import
editableByProps: Starting mood and the three background colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change slider track and thumb look

fixed: Root is full-bleed at full viewport height and the slider is fixed to the bottom of the screen
Element ids in the SVGs are global, so only one instance should be on a page
